name: Praying For Each Other
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of praying for one another as an expression of love and spiritual unity. Believers are called to intercede even for their enemies, reflecting Christ's teaching to bless and pray for those who persecute them (Matthew 5:44). The power of united prayer is highlighted in Matthew 18:19, where agreement in prayer brings divine response. The Spirit aids believers in prayer, interceding on their behalf beyond their understanding (Romans 8:26), while the apostolic example urges persistent, collective prayer for one another's needs and spiritual strength (Romans 15:30; Ephesians 6:18). Together, these verses reveal that mutual prayer fosters both practical support and deep spiritual partnership among believers (Ecclesiastes 4:9).
